clips.title: The story
paras: Darsok Swiftdagger is an orc warrior and scout stationed at the Crossroads in the heart of the Barrens. Known for his fierce hatred of harpies, he directs Horde adventurers north into the Dry Hills to break the avian matriarchy harassing travelers and settlements. He is also an old friend of Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin.

Amid the bustling hub of the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger keeps a sharp eye on the threats creeping out of the northern scrubland. The trade artery connecting Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern reaches is under constant siege, not only from raiders and centaur, but from organized aerial hunters. Darsok focuses his wrath on the Witchwing harpies, whose roosts in the Dry Hills northwest of the Forgotten Pools directly threaten northern caravans.

While his immediate duties center around harpy eradication, Darsok Swiftdagger has an old friend far to the northwest: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, the troll who lives at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, the land the harpies come from. Darsok sends Jin'Zil a letter with news of the harpy campaign, though the two have not been in touch for many years.
